bio:
Rita is one of the friendly faces welcoming dogs and their owners to The Pet Studio. She enjoys getting to know customers, helping appointments run smoothly and seeing dogs leave the salon looking and feeling their best.

A lifelong dog lover, Rita previously owned and showed Golden Retrievers at championship shows. She now shares her life with Daisy, a small rescue Maltese who thoroughly enjoys being pampered. Rita’s warmth and genuine interest in every dog help make the reception experience feel personal and welcoming from the moment clients arrive.
